card.statement:
[(a)] For each
$\mathcal P$-system ${\cal U}$, there exists a block matrix $A=[A_1|\dots|A_t]$ such that $f(A)$ defined in <<ref:bbr>> is isometric to ${\cal U}$.

- [(b)] Two block matrices $A$ and $B$ are weakly unitarily $\cal P$-equivalent if and only if $f(A)$ and $f(B)$ are isometric.
card.label: Lemma 1

paper.title: Systems of subspaces of a unitary space
paper.abstract: For a given poset, we consider its representations by systems of subspaces of a unitary space ordered by inclusion. We classify such systems for all posets for which an explicit classification is possible.
